name: user-management-context
description: User management app built on a centralized, versioned context (requirements, ADRs, contract) enforced by CI and served to agents over MCP.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/api & npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w tools/context-server && npm run test:scripts
scripts.gates: npm run context:manifest:check && npm run context:validate && npm run context:trace && npm run lint:contract
